stories.title: Bitcoin climbs back to about $80,000 after its midterm whipsaw
stories.summary: Bitcoin dropped to about $75,600 as results showed Democrats sweeping Congress, then rallied past $81,000 on Wednesday as traders betting on further falls were forced to buy back. It was still near $80,000 in the US evening, and ether rose more than bitcoin. Money was still leaving US bitcoin funds.
points: Bitcoin rebounded from an intraday low of $75,618 to above $81,000, its first time there since 29 Oct, per Bitcoin.com News.
In the early evening of 4 Nov bitcoin was up 3.64% at $80,156 and ether up 6.58% at $2,421.50, per The Motley Fool.
About $950M of positions were liquidated in 24 hours, $560M of them bets on falling prices, per CoinGlass data cited by Unchained; The Block put the total at about $469M.
US bitcoin ETFs lost $115.56M on Tuesday 3 Nov, per Bitcoin.com News.
Bitfinex analysts said recent recoveries have been driven mainly by short covering, per Bitcoin.com News.

stories.title: Democrats take Congress and the crypto industry rethinks its Washington plan
stories.summary: With Democrats winning both chambers, analysts now see the industry-backed CLARITY Act as unlikely to move. House Democrats have begun discussing their own market-structure bill that would give the SEC a bigger role, and tokens linked to the Trump family fell.
points: TD Cowen says CLARITY is unlikely to advance over the next two years, per The Block.
The crypto-backed Fairshake PAC spent $154.5 million this cycle, per The Block.
CLARITY failed a Senate vote 49-50 in September; the new Congress takes office in January, per Decrypt.
Democrats' ideas would give the SEC a bigger supervisory role and narrow the CFTC's, per crypto.news.
The TRUMP token fell 17% in 24 hours to $1.33 and WLFI fell more than 7%, per Yahoo Finance.

stories.title: Hack wave: Binance refills reserves, a French bank confirms its loss, a Brazilian exchange is hit
stories.summary: Binance says it has replenished most of the assets taken in its record hack while North Korean hackers keep laundering the loot. France's Crédit Mutuel Arkéa confirmed a sophisticated attack in line with investigators' estimate of more than $133M, and Brazil's Mercado Bitcoin also lost tens of millions.
points: Binance says it has replenished about 98% of affected assets and its latest reserve snapshot covers 44 tokens, per The Defiant.
Hackers resumed laundering the Binance loot through THORChain; RUNE rose 10.6% to $0.637, per CoinDesk.
Binance net outflows reached $5.28B after the hack, per CoinDesk.
Crédit Mutuel Arkéa said it could validate the order of magnitude of the estimate and that the loss does not threaten its solvency, per The Record.
Mercado Bitcoin's preliminary losses are about $38M, with independent analyses suggesting up to $49M, per cryptonews.net.
